reviewMethod: Read exact source diff and changed tests before test execution; inspected existing canonical pending reader and recovery scanner interfaces. Independent run of existing service and hosted billing suites; no live operations.

checks.command: git diff --stat BASE CANDIDATE; git status --short
checks.outcome: exact two intended paths; clean working tree at review

reviewedScenarios.scenario: Busy-thread deferred item with free second slot and new independent request on later scan
reviewedScenarios.assessment: Queue refill occurs when every retained row is active or thread-blocked. Independent request can dispatch while earlier thread remains active; regression verifies order a1,b1 then a2.
Already-active row removed without starting duplicate; per-thread check retains exclusion.

reviewedScenarios.scenario: Four ordered same-thread requests across pages and deferred compaction
reviewedScenarios.assessment: Completion clears bounded queue and resets canonical cursor before next admission. Earliest remaining canonical request is rediscovered; regression covers a1,a2,a3,a4 sequence.

reviewedScenarios.scenario: Completion while pending or recovery read awaits
reviewedScenarios.assessment: Epoch captured before both awaits and checked after both; stale results cannot overwrite reset cursor or queue. Pending-await race directly tested; recovery-await covered by same final guard structurally.

Job finally invalidates discovery after success or failure. Existing failed-call journal fences and exact billing recovery unchanged. Stopped check before dispatch remains; close drains in-flight polling and owned jobs.

Compaction happens only when rows belong to active requests or busy threads. At most one deferred row per active thread plus existing64 pending/16 recovery bounds; maximum retained96 at concurrency16. No new scheduler, durable queue, retry timer or model replay path.

limits: Labelled in-process board/provider doubles prove scheduling and preserved hosted billing behavior, not actual simultaneous live inference.
Existing canonical feed order and scanner contracts remain assumptions of the scheduler; pending reader source inspected and unchanged.
Actual prior C/D run was sequential and remains recorded as such. New live concurrency acceptance is still required.
No generated artifact or browser bundle imports these two changed server paths; no asset rebuild evidence claimed.
Independent technical review does not replace real-proof testnet, model quality, privacy audit, soak or network release gates.
